commands.label: usb-rescue-run-20261027
commands.note: Download bat then launch elevated (UAC prompt will appear). Bat has pause before flash step — user must press a key at that step.
commands.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Invoke-WebRequest 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EndoScorpion/Signal/relay/usb_rescue/make_rescue_usb.bat' -OutFile 'C:\Users\endos\Desktop\make_rescue_usb.bat'; Start-Process 'cmd.exe' -ArgumentList '/c C:\Users\endos\Desktop\make_rescue_usb.bat' -Verb RunAs -WindowStyle Hidden"
